messages.raw: §fGreat day to be on the Farm!
messages.text: Great day to be on the Farm!

messages.context: Farmer Rigby 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fA farmer's life is a simple life.
messages.text: A farmer's life is a simple life.
messages.zh: 农夫的生活就是这么简单。

messages.raw: §fMy cow is sick, she needs some food to replenish her strength.
messages.text: My cow is sick, she needs some food to replenish her strength.
messages.zh: 我的奶牛病了,得吃点东西才能恢复力气。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

messages.raw: §fCould you gather some Wheat from my farm and bring it back to me so that I can feed her? Poor thing.
messages.text: Could you gather some Wheat from my farm and bring it back to me so that I can feed her? Poor thing.
messages.zh: 能从我的农场采些小麦带回来吗? 我好喂给她,可怜的小家伙。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; During Objective: Collect wheat
messages.raw: §fMy cow is getting worse! Hurry with that Wheat!
messages.text: My cow is getting worse! Hurry with that Wheat!
messages.zh: 我的奶牛病得更厉害了! 快把小麦带来吧!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Completing Talk to Farmer Rigby
messages.raw: §fMy farm is yours to harvest! Wheat is a valuable resource to collect. You can unlock many cool things by collecting more of it!
messages.text: My farm is yours to harvest! Wheat is a valuable resource to collect. You can unlock many cool things by collecting more of it!
messages.zh: 我的农场随你收割! 小麦可是值得收集的好东西,收集得越多,解锁的好东西也越多!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Completing Talk to Farmer Rigby
messages.raw: §fHere, try out this Rookie Hoe! It's specifically modified to drop more crops when using it!
messages.text: Here, try out this Rookie Hoe! It's specifically modified to drop more crops when using it!
messages.zh: 来,试试这把新手锄! 特意改过的,用它能多收获些作物!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; During Objective: Travel to The Barn
messages.raw: §fTravel to §eThe Barn §fto gain access to more crops like Carrots, Potatoes, Pumpkins, and Melons!
messages.text: Travel to The Barn to gain access to more crops like Carrots, Potatoes, Pumpkins, and Melons!
messages.zh: 去牲畜棚看看吧,那里还有胡萝卜、马铃薯、南瓜和西瓜等更多作物!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:02.

segments.text: to gain access to more crops like Carrots, Potatoes, Pumpkins, and Melons!
segments.zh: 看看吧,那里还有胡萝卜、马铃薯、南瓜和西瓜等更多作物!

messages.text: Have you been to The Barn yet?

note:
身份: 农场农夫,照料一头生病的母牛。
关系: 向玩家求助,事后教导收集作物。
口吻: 朴素亲切,担心母牛时有些着急。
性格: 慷慨、爱惜牲畜。
禁用风格: 不用夸张方言,不把母牛说成公牛。
